name: Shooting Star candlestick short (8 criteria)
author: je-suis-tm
indicators: criteria: red/near-open body, lower_bound 0.2 wick rule, body_size 0.5x mean body, upper wick >= 2x body, prior 2 closes rising; next candle high<star high and close<star close
implementation_notes: Exact exit hold in code. Entry uses confirmation candle (waits for t+1) - ok no lookahead if entered at t+1 close. Repo note: educational scripts (Yahoo/histdata), not production.
